ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly bimodal; high-intensity white pixels cover approximately 40% of the lateral lobes, while low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels cover approximately 60% concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity regions on distal lobes; a dark central V-shaped region; distinct yellowish-brown chromatic patches centered in the light regions; scattered low-intensity focal points (mottling) within the white areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels; significant jagged protrusions localized at the terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into a convex sweep towards the distal lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer margins and distal tips; two distinct circular greyish-white mottled patches in the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark diagonal linear disruption (scratch) on the lower-left light lobe; multiple fine horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle attachments on the leading and trailing edges of the terminal tips; circular healed scarring in the central axial zone.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown staining localized within the white pigmentation zones of both lobes.
